name: TLE2081 / TLE2082 / TLE2084
tagline: TI's fast Excalibur JFET op-amp (40 V/µs, 10 MHz, 38 V), a lively, clean budget pick among Head-Fi CMoy builders.

lineage.note: Sole source. Earliest artifact: TLE2082 macromodel 02/11/91. SLOS105 (1991), SLOS182 (1997, revised 2001, 2026).

part_numbers.note: Single; TI folder live. PSpice SLOJ115; macromodels /301, /302 dated 04/05/94, 04/06/94.
Tighter-offset A grade of the single; shares SLOJ115.
Dual, the audio favourite. C/I/M grades; TLE2082CP (PDIP-8) live. PSpice model SLOJ116.
A grade of the dual; orderables seen in third-party copies.
Chip (die) form; dropped from Rev C title, probably discontinued. TLE2081Y/TLE2084Y may have existed.
Quad; TI folder live. CDW is SOIC-16 wide. Macromodels dated 04/05/94, 04/06/94.
A grade of the quad. PSpice model SLOJ117.

key_specs.source: TI PSpice macromodels; TI product page

reputation.summary: A budget favourite, not a legend. Head-Fi CMoy threads (c. 2007–2009) group it with its sister TLE2072 as a good cheap op-amp for 9 V CMoys: the TLE2072 has better DC specs, the TLE2082 better AC specs. Users call the TLE2082 'lively, clean, detailed'. No published distortion or noise measurements found.
typical_uses: Input/driver stage for discrete headphone outputs (ohdsp AmpTwo)
Fast JFET buffering and filtering, e.g. SampleScope
Proposed MC33182D replacement in the Gameboy DSO
caveats: Small evidence base: a few Head-Fi CMoy threads, no measurements.
Noise (about 11.6 nV/√Hz) is well above bipolar audio parts like NE5532 (about 5 nV/√Hz).
About 25 mA output: low-impedance headphones need a buffer or discrete stage.
Fast (10 MHz, 40 V/µs): decouple closely and watch capacitive loads in TL07x-era circuits.
Praise predates the 2023 RFAB die revision; new-production parts may differ.

counterfeit_notes: No specific reports. A low-volume, cheap part and unlikely target, but treat marketplace 'TLE2082' DIPs as unverified. Bench check: about 40 V/µs slew and tens of pA bias; a remarked TL072/TL082 slews only about 13 V/µs.

part_numbers_affected: TLE2081 / TLE2081A / TLE2082 / TLE2082A / TLE2084 / TLE2084A (datasheet Rev C scope; PCN coverage of other orderables not confirmed)
silicon_changes.identification: Same part number; PCN die-revision field becomes A, chip site RFAB, new assembly site. Identify by date code versus the (unknown) first-ship date.
silicon_changes.summary: PCN 20231219013.1 (19 Dec 2023; Mouser copy 22 Dec 2023) moves TLE208x to RFAB with a die revision and assembly change. Datasheet Rev C (March 2026) then dropped 'BiFET', slew-rate and offset-trim features and 'JFET-Input' from the title, as TI did after TL07x die changes. Linking the two is inferred.

revision_history.changes: Original TLE2082/TLE2082A/TLE2082Y dual-only datasheet; known from the Rev A header.
37 pages. 28 V/µs min, 10 MHz typ (8 min), 1.5 mA/ch, Vos max 7 mV (4 mV A), ±2.25 V to ±19 V.
Combined TLE208x/TLE208xA/TLE208xY single, dual and quad datasheet; presumably superseded SLOS105.
Implied by Rev B; not seen. Between Feb 1997 and Jun 2001.
Claims over 2x bandwidth (10 MHz) and 3x slew (45 V/µs) of TL07x/TL08x, ±19 V rails, zener-trimmed offset in A grades.
Modern TI format; dropped BiFET, slew-rate and offset-trim features; added Applications and filter figure; title drops JFET-Input and Y forms.

revision_chains.note: Pre-2026 Wayback captures of the tle2082 symlink should hold Rev B. Older mirrors may hold earlier editions.
